notes: Homepage title: 'High Quality Essentials, Radically Low Prices'; banner 'High-quality essentials at radical prices' and 'Free shipping & easy returns for 365 days'. First category tiles: Sweaters, Bags, Cashmere, Jewelry; '$50 Cashmere' promo at the top (https://www.quince.com/).

About: 'factory-direct model that cuts out the supply-chain middlemen and reduces costs'; avoids 'sourcing agents, warehousing, wholesaling, distribution and storefront retail'; eco-friendly materials 'whenever possible' incl. cashmere, alpaca wool, organic cotton, organic linen, 100% recycled polyester; partners only with factories who 'meet or exceed global guidelines for workplace safety and equitable wages' (https://www.quince.com/about).

Shipping & returns: 'Standard shipping is always free.' 'Most items can be returned for free for a full refund or exchange within 365 days of delivery date.' Exceptions: gold bars, caviar and wine, engagement rings (60 days), furniture (30 days, 15% restocking), rugs/mirrors/made-to-order ($35), wall art, final sale. 'Quince currently ships within Canada and the United States' (https://www.quince.com/shipping-returns).

Mongolian Cashmere Crewneck Sweater: '100% Grade A Mongolian Cashmere', '12-gauge jersey knit'; sizes XS–XL, with 1X–3X on a separate extended listing (https://www.quince.com/women/cashmere/cashmere-crewneck-sweater?color=heather-grey).

Wikipedia: San Francisco; founded 2019 as Last Brand, renamed Quince June 2020 (infobox says 2018); founders Sid Gupta, Sourabh Mahajan, Becky Mortimer, Zunu Mittal; markets a 'manufacturer-to-consumer' model. Lawsuits listed: Williams-Sonoma (Nov 2025, comparison ads), Tapestry/Coach (Apr 2025, trade dress), Yeti and Deckers/UGG IP disputes (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quince_(company)).

Dresses page (https://www.quince.com/women/dresses, 2026-10-29): 16 dresses shown, $59.90–$159.90, incl. washable silk slip dresses $114.90 and cotton cashmere ribbed midi dresses $59.90–$77. Named as a Tuckernuck alternative by The Pink Chickadee and TeriLyn Adams.

Handbags (2026-10-29): Women's Bags & Leather Goods page lists 330 items incl. Hudson Suede Tote $174, Sloane Handwoven Mini Shoulder Bag $120, Clement Large Shoulder Bag $198 (https://www.quince.com/shop/women/bags-&-leather-goods).
2026-10-29 (comfrt run): women's sweatshirts page lists Mongolian Cashmere Full-Zip Hoodie $119.90 (Best seller badge) and Flowknit Full-Zip Hoodie $44.90; no strikethrough prices.
